subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The decision taken by the director is a/(an) __judicious__ one.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3' **i.e. **'Thoughtful'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **'Judicious' **means having, showing, or done with good judgment or sense.(विवेकी).

 
 
• **Example:** The doctor made a judicious decision to proceed with the surgery.
 
 
 
• The synonym** 'Thoughtful' **means absorbed in or involving thought or showing consideration for the needs of other people.(सोच विचार करना).
 
 
• **Example:** It was very thoughtful of you to send her flowers when she was sick.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is '**Thoughtful'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Honest'** as per Option 1 means free of deceit and untruthfulness; sincere.(ईमानदार)
 
• **'Irrational'** as per Option 2 is not logical or reasonable.(तर्कहीन)
 
• **'Foolish' **as per Option 4 means lacking good sense or judgement; unwise. (मूर्खतापूर्ण)
